messages:
anna: Heads-up — AcmeCloud (marketplace vendor) is asking about removing the legacy compatibility shim we shipped for their integration. They want a 'shimless' path and a clear announcement cadence.

leo-partner: Thanks Anna. Our engineers hit the shim in the wild when packaging the marketplace adapter. It's causing request header double-encoding and added 50ms p95. We're ready to drop it but partners need a runway.

devon: Can we get a plan that avoids breaking marketplace installs? Thinking: feature-flag enable for 2 weeks, then opt-out deprecation notice, then remove after one billing cycle.

maria: @devon we should also surface telemetry — how many partners are still behind shim. I can add instrumentation to the adapter registry. Need ~3 days to ship.

anna: Proposed timeline: 1) telemetry roll (maria, 3d) 2) opt-in flag for new installs (1w) 3) announce grace period (30 days) 4) removal window (after 60 days). Thoughts?

samir: For Dedicated customers we need a separate comms path — private deployments may not get registry updates. Ops runbooks need to include manual migration steps.

leo-partner: Agree on Dedicated path. Also marketplace listing needs fields: "shim_removed": boolean and migration_notes link. Can the Console show a deprecation badge?

devon: Yes, Console can show a 'shim deprecation' banner per listing. I'll add a small UI ticket.

maria: Telemetry plan: add metric `partner_shim_usage{partner}` + a rolling count and a small healthcheck. Will also emit an event to the partner-telemetry topic so partners can peek their usage.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for telemetry service started on infra-canary-3 (build 5472).

anna: Communication plan checklist: - partner pre-brief (private email + partner Slack) - public marketplace advisory - docs migration guide + code snippets - sample PR for marketplace packaging - sunset date + rollback plan. Who owns each?

leo-partner: I'll own partner pre-brief and provide partner-specific test packages.

maria: Docs + code snippets — I can draft. Will include `curl` example and a Python snippet showing header changes.

samir: I'll write the Dedicated runbook and a migration playbook for on-prem SIs. Include a `sed` snippet to patch config for older installs.

devon: Engineering owners: I'll own the feature-flag rollout and the Console banner ticket. We should gate removal on < 3% active shim usage across marketplace installs.

anna: Agreement: runway = telemetry (3d) -> feature-flag (1w) -> public advisory + 30d grace -> remove after 60d if usage < 3% OR manual partner signoff otherwise.

leo-partner: One wrinkle: two large SI partners asked for a longer grace period for scheduled maintenance windows. Suggest we offer extended grace on request, but mark clearly in the marketplace.

maria: Good call. We'll add an "extended_grace" flag in partner telemetry so we can exclude them from the auto-removal threshold.

samir: Risk log: - Unexpected botched installs on Dedicated -> mitigation: hotfix playbook + rollback artifacts - Marketplace packages that embed legacy header logic -> mitigation: code samples + Marketplace pre-scan checks.

anna: Comms draft: short partner email + public advisory draft by EOD Friday. Tagging folks: @leo-partner, @maria, @devon, @samir.

leo-partner: I'll draft partner email and ping legal for wording.

maria: Drafting docs now, will post a PR to docs repo and link in thread.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Reminder — please register the change in the change calendar for 2024-02-10.

anna: Closing notes: schedule tabletop with two SI reps next Tue, and confirm dedicated runbook availability. If anything blocks, call it out in this thread. :thumbsup:
